close_reason: Updated create_object doc comment with invariant and RFC 8620 §5.3 citation; added TODO in MockBackend; cargo test passes
description:
**What:** Add explicit doc comment invariant to SharingBackend::create_object in backend.rs: the returned O MUST have its id field set to the server-assigned Id (returned_obj.id == assigned_id). The handler relies on this to populate the created response map per RFC 8620 §5.3.

**Algorithm:**
1. Update the doc comment on create_object in backend.rs to add the invariant sentence.
2. In lib.rs test_support MockBackend::create_object, add a comment confirming it satisfies this invariant.
3. Run cargo doc --no-deps -p jmap-sharing-server to verify rendering.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Doc comment clearly states the invariant with RFC 8620 §5.3 citation.
- cargo test -p jmap-sharing-server exits 0.
title: Doc: clarify create_object must return object with server-assigned id
